We need to provide an answer. We can ask clarifying questions? But we might interpret they want info on who plays next game(s) in Spanish league. Could use external knowledge but no tool available for retrieving fixture list. There's only one function defined: get last match result between two teams. That doesn't help with listing all teams currently playing. So maybe respond asking clarification: do you mean today's matches? Or what specific match?

Alternatively could give general explanation: In La Liga there are many teams; each week certain pairings play. Provide example of typical schedule. Might mention top clubs like Real Madrid, Barcelona etc.

But better to clarify: Which match/teams? Also note cannot fetch real-time data without API. So ask them to specify teams or dates.
